justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation uses four-input XNOR because the complete waveform truth table is even parity. Original one-bit ports and combinational semantics are preserved, with no added latency.
static_review: Single continuous assignment, no storage, no reset or clock, one-bit operands and output. Testbench uses explicit original table values and zero-delay settling at original timestamps.
